blocks.text: I couldn’t identify a complete eligible award itinerary from San Francisco (SFO) to Bangkok (BKK) for January 2027. The award results are leads rather than bookable end-to-end schedules: they don’t include flight times, connection details, or whole-journey durations. For a cash reference on the requested SFO–BKK route, the January 1 search returned this fare:
The lowest displayed cash quote in this search.
blocks.label: Lowest cash quote

blocks.text: That quote departs late on January 1 and arrives on January 4. The alternatives below show the schedule-versus-price tradeoff: the January 2 arrival option costs more, while the January 3 option is a less expensive middle ground. These are cash-search observations, not award recommendations.
An earlier arrival than the lowest quote, for a higher displayed fare.
blocks.label: Earlier cash arrival

blocks.text: A middle option on both arrival time and displayed fare.
blocks.label: Cash middle ground

blocks.text: A still earlier arrival, but at a substantially higher displayed fare.
blocks.label: Fastest cash schedule

blocks.text: In the observed schedules, C3 arrives late on January 2, about 35 hours before the lowest-quote itinerary, but leaves SFO about 11 hours earlier and costs $318 more. C2 arrives the morning of January 3, about 23 hours before the lowest-quote arrival, while leaving about 11 hours earlier and costing $46 more. C5 gets in about 13 hours before C3 and departs nearly 12 hours later, but its displayed fare is $431 higher. The cash amounts are the quoted amounts shown in the search; their price scope is not independently established, so don’t treat them as confirmed per-traveler or party totals.

There are award-search leads on the requested SFO–BKK route, including economy results for January 1. One reports United miles and another Alaska miles, but neither supplies enough itinerary detail to assess departure or arrival times, connections, or total travel time. Their displayed award prices also have unknown scope, so they cannot establish the cash or points total for your trip.
A January 1 SFO–BKK economy award lead; itinerary details and price scope are not established.
blocks.label: United economy lead, Jan 1

blocks.text: A January 1 SFO–BKK economy award lead; itinerary details and price scope are not established.
blocks.label: Alaska economy lead, Jan 1

blocks.text: A possible alternative to searching only SFO–BKK is to investigate travel via Taipei (TPE), where award leads also appear. But the available SFO–TPE and TPE–BKK results are separate component observations, not a complete connecting itinerary: they do not establish compatible schedules, a protected connection, or a whole-trip price. The Bangkok component shown here is dated January 2, so it also does not match a January 1 arrival plan without further schedule and date checking.
An SFO–TPE economy award lead for January 1; it does not establish a connection to Bangkok.
blocks.label: Taipei positioning lead

blocks.text: A TPE–BKK business award lead for January 2; it does not establish a connection from SFO.
blocks.label: Bangkok business lead, Jan 2

blocks.text: All search observations are dated October 9, 2026, rather than live availability. Confirm schedules, award space, connection feasibility, and the full price with the relevant providers before making plans. The independent explorer contains the wider eligible inventory; nearby date variants are not listed here because they do not resolve the missing end-to-end itinerary details.
